messages:
Rhea Gupta: Heads-up — Marigold Systems dropped to ~0 inference calls since yesterday evening. Renewal in ~5 weeks. They were ~14k tokens/day last week. Flagging for triage.
Liam O'Connor: Noted. Any sign of billing hold or champion churn?
Sam Park: Their engineering lead accepted a new role; new infra lead took over earlier today. I see SR-12188 referencing a feature-flag rollback and a pending invoice in billing. No 5xx in our telemetry.
Alicia Gomez: Pulled recent auth events: spike of 403s then a sequence of 401s from one IP block. Likely key rotation + IP policy change. Quick query I ran:
```sql
SELECT ts, event FROM auth_events WHERE org='marigold' AND ts >= '2026-03-20' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;
```
Alicia Gomez: Uploaded SR and the auth dump to /shared/marigold/sr-12188.zip.
Rhea Gupta: Possible causes: (1) procurement paused billing, (2) infra enforces new IP allowlist, (3) devs toggled a local stub after noticing occasional 5xx earlier. Proposed next steps: 1) short IP-restricted token (48h) + note on expiry, 2) offer a focused perf + integration session (30m) and 25k token credit, 3) schedule a 20-min unblock call with the new infra lead and procurement.
Liam O'Connor: Good. Also prepare a one-pager TCO vs VelvetAI (they demoed last Fri) that emphasizes our burst capacity and managed fallbacks. I'll coordinate AE and legal for invoice/contract questions.
Sam Park: SE config suggestion — safe defaults to try while they re-enable:
```yaml
inference:
  prefix_cache: true
  batch_size: 8
  keep_warm: true
```
Sam Park: And a tiny warmup curl for CI:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/run -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":1}'
```
Alicia Gomez: Draft outreach (<=150 words) for Rhea to send. Keep it unemotional and focused on unblocking tests.
Rhea Gupta: Draft outreach: "Hi Jordan — we noticed your integration tests paused after your infra changes and a key rotation. To help unblock, we can issue an IP-restricted 48h token and run a 30-min SE session to verify SAML / key config. Would 20 mins this week to walk security and infra through the steps work? — Rhea (CSM)"
Liam O'Connor: Add one sentence offering to coordinate billing with procurement if invoice holds are blocking tests. Also ask for preferred contact for the infra lead (email/Slack).
Rhea Gupta: Updated and sent. ticket-bot: SR-12188 linked to renewal task MG-512. Priority set to HIGH by Rhea Gupta.
ticket-bot: SR-12188: note added "offer 48h IP token + 25k credit; schedule 20-min unblock call".
Sam Park: I'll prep the perf snapshot and a 2-step infra note (<200 words) we can paste into outreach. ETA EOD.
Alicia Gomez: Uploaded VelvetAI demo notes and procurement asks for comparison.
Liam O'Connor: If usage doesn't resume within 7 days after the unblock call we escalate to AE for exec outreach. Closing interim actions here and will update after the call.
